y-m-58-08.title: Kana pane vertex asi isiri mukosha mudiki
y-m-58-08.topic: Zvekutanga zvekushandisa quadratic functions: mukosha mudiki pachiyero chakaganhurirwa
y-m-58-08.goal: Ziva kuti kana domain yakaganhurirwa, mukosha mudiki wefunction unogona kusarudzwa pamugumo wechiyero panzvimbo pevertex, wana uye ugadzirise kukanganisa, uye wobva wawana machiyero anokodzera mamiriro iwe amene.
y-m-58-08.material: Fungidzira function f(x)=(x−2)². Girafu yayo ine vertex pa (2, 0) uye inovhura kumusoro (x kana iri kure ne2, f(x) inova huru). Kana domain yakaganhurirwa kwete kunhamba dzose chaiyo asi kuchiyero chakavharwa [a, b], tinowana mukosha mukuru nemudiki we f.
y-m-58-08.prereq.0: Kufungidzira kuti unoziva girafu yequadratic function y=(x−p)² (vertex, symmetry, kuvhura kumusoro)
y-m-58-08.s.s1.prompt: Iyi mhinduro yekana domain i 3 ≤ x ≤ 5. Sarudza mutsara usina kururama.
y-m-58-08.s.s1.hint.0: Ongorora kana x-coordinate yevertex 2 iri mukati mechiyero 3 ≤ x ≤ 5.
y-m-58-08.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kuti ndeipi diki zvikuru pakati pekukosha kwemutsara 2.
y-m-58-08.s.s1.line.0: Girafu ye f(x)=(x−2)² iparabola inovhura kumusoro ine vertex pa (2, 0).
y-m-58-08.s.s1.line.2: Y-coordinate yevertex i0, saka mukosha mudiki muchiyero ichi i0 futi.
y-m-58-08.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 3 ndiko kukanganisa. X-coordinate yevertex 2 haisi mukati mechiyero 3 ≤ x ≤ 5. Saka mukosha mudiki i f(3)=1, pa x=3, poinzi yechiyero iri padhuze ne2.
y-m-58-08.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza machiyero ose umo mukosha mudiki we f i0 kana domain iri chiyero ichocho.
y-m-58-08.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wawana kukosha kwe x umo f(x)=0.
y-m-58-08.s.s2.hint.1: Ongorora kana chiyero chega chega chichisanganisira kukosha kwe x iko.
y-m-58-08.s.s2.r.a: Pangava pawakatarisa upamhi hwechiyero chete kana chikamu chekukosha usina kuongorora kana vertex iri muchiyero.
y-m-58-08.s.s2.r.b: Iyi isarudzo inoziva kuti migumo yechiyero yakasanganisirwawo mudomain.
y-m-58-08.s.s2.r.c: Pangava pawakafunga kuti mukosha mudiki i0 kunyange vertex iri kunze kwechiyero.
y-m-58-08.s.s2.r.d: Iyi isarudzo yakaongorora nyaya umo vertex iri mukati mechiyero.
y-m-58-08.s.s2.r.e: Iyi isarudzo yakaziva kuti vertex yakasanganisirwa kunyange kana iri pamugumo wechiyero.
y-m-58-08.s.s2.explain: Kuti mukosha mudiki ive 0, x=2, umo f(x)=0, inofanira kuva muchiyero. 0 ≤ x ≤ 2, 1 ≤ x ≤ 4 ne 2 ≤ x ≤ 2.5 zvinosanganisira 2, nepo −2 ≤ x ≤ 1 ne 3 ≤ x ≤ 6 zvisingasanganisire.
y-m-58-08.s.s3.prompt: Sarudza maintegers a, b (a<b) kuti usete chiyero [a, b] uye uwane uye uise machiyero ose umo mukosha mudiki we f muchiyero ichi i1 uye mukosha mukuru i9. (Machiyero 2 akasiyana)
y-m-58-08.s.s3.hint.0: Wana x ine mukosha mukuru 9 kubva pa (x−2)²=9 uye uedze kuiisa pamugumo mumwe wechiyero.
y-m-58-08.s.s3.hint.1: Ongorora kuti mukosha mudiki unova chii kana chiyero ichocho chichisanganisira x=2.
y-m-58-08.s.s3.fail.c1: a ne b zvinofanira kuva maintegers ane a<b.
y-m-58-08.s.s3.fail.c3: Mukosha mudiki muchiyero ichi haisi 1. Kana vertex x=2 iri mukati mechiyero, mukosha mudiki i0.
y-m-58-08.s.s3.explain: Mukosha mukuru 9 unoitika pa x iri 3 kure ne2 (−1 kana 5), uye mukosha mudiki 1 unoitika pa x iri 1 kure ne2 (1 kana 3). Kana chiyero chichisanganisira vertex 2, mukosha mudiki unova 0, saka machiyero maviri chete [3, 5] ne [−1, 1] ndiwo anogoneka.

y-m-58-01.title: Kuti kuenderana kuve 'basa'
y-m-58-01.topic: Chirevo chebasa: mamiriro okuti kuenderana kuve basa
y-m-58-01.goal: Shandisa mamiriro maviri okuti 'chinhu chega chega chedomain chinoenderana (hapana chakasiiwa), uye chimwe chete chaizvo' nemhando yecodomain kumakuenderana chaiwo kuti utonge, uye vaka chirevo chinosangana namamiriro iwe pachako.
y-m-58-01.material: Mukirasi, basa rakatsanangurwa nenzira iyi: 'Kana chinhu x chega chega cheseti X chichienderana nechinhu chimwe chete chaizvo cheseti Y, kuenderana uku kunonzi basa kubva ku X kuenda ku Y.' Nhasi X ndi {1, 2, 3, 4} uye Y ndi {0, 1, 2, 3}. Pane makuenderana mana (가) kusvika (라).

y-m-58-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza makuenderana ose ari mabasa kubva ku X kuenda ku Y. (Makuenderana: 가) chasara kana x yaparadzanwa ne 3 나) x−1 다) nhamba dziri muna Y dziri shoma pa x 라) x−2)
y-m-58-01.s.s1.hint.0: Isa x se 1, 2, 3, 4 rimwe panguva imwe uye unyore kukosha kunopiwa nokuenderana kwega kwega patafura.
y-m-58-01.s.s1.hint.1: Kune x yega yega, tarisa zvakasiyana kuti pane kukosha kungani uye kana kukosha iko kuri muna Y.
y-m-58-01.s.s1.o.a: (다) Enzanisa x nenhamba dziri muna Y dziri shoma pa x
y-m-58-01.s.s1.r.a: Unogona kunge wakasarudza nokutarisa zita rokuenderana chete usina kuongorora kana kukosha kwakagadziriswa kuva kumwe ('chimwe chete chaizvo').
y-m-58-01.s.s1.o.b: (가) Enzanisa x nechasara kana x yaparadzanwa ne 3
y-m-58-01.s.s1.r.b: Iyi isarudzo yakaitwa nokuisa x se 1, 2, 3, 4 rimwe panguva imwe uye kutarisa kana kukosha kuri kumwe uye kuri muna Y.
y-m-58-01.s.s1.r.c: Unogona kunge wakatarisa chete kana x yega yega ine kukosha kumwe, uye hauna kutarisa kana kukosha uko kuri muna Y.
y-m-58-01.s.s1.r.d: Iyi isarudzo yakaitwa nokutsvaga kukosha kwe x yose uye kuenzanisa na Y.
y-m-58-01.s.s1.explain: (가) ndi 1→1, 2→2, 3→0, 4→1 uye (나) ndi 1→0, 2→1, 3→2, 4→3, saka zvose zvine kukosha kumwe uye ziri muna Y. Mu (다), kana x=2 kukosha kuviri, 0 ne 1, kunoenderana, saka 'chimwe chete chaizvo' kunoputsika, uye mu (라), kana x=1, −1 iri kunze kwa Y.
y-m-58-01.s.s2.prompt: Jihu akati (다) ibasa. Sarudza mutsetse wakanganisa munharo yaJihu.
y-m-58-01.s.s2.hint.0: Cherechedza pamutsetse wega wega kuti mutsara unotarisa rimwe re 'mamiriro maviri etsananguro'.
y-m-58-01.s.s2.hint.1: Pamutsetse wega wega, tarisa zvakasiyana kuti kukosha kungani kunoenderana na x uye kana kukosha iko kuri mukati muna Y.
y-m-58-01.s.s2.line.0: (다) inoenzanisa x nenhamba dziri muna Y dziri shoma pa x.
y-m-58-01.s.s2.line.1: Kana x=1, nhamba chete iri muna Y iri shoma pa 1 ndi 0.
y-m-58-01.s.s2.line.2: Kana x=2, nhamba dziri muna Y dziri shoma pa 2 ndi 0 ne 1, mbiri.
y-m-58-01.s.s2.line.3: Kukosha kwose mbiri kuri muna Y, saka mamiriro azadziswa, uye (다) ibasa.
y-m-58-01.s.s2.line.4: Saka (다) ibasa kubva ku X kuenda ku Y.
y-m-58-01.s.s2.explain: Mutsetse 4 ndiwo kukanganisa. Basa rinofanira kuva kwete nokukosha kwaro kuri muna Y chete asi rinofanirawo kuva ne 'chimwe chete chaizvo' kune x yega yega. Zvose 0 ne 1 zvinoenderana na x=2, saka haribasa. Mutsetse 5 mhedziso inovimba mutsetse 4, saka inoputsika pamwe chete nawo.
y-m-58-01.s.s3.prompt: Ikozvino wedzera codomain kuva Y'={0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8}. Gadzira basa f(x)=px+q (p ne q inhamba dzizere) kubva ku X={1, 2, 3, 4} kuenda ku Y' kuti x dzakasiyana dzienderane nokukosha kwakasiyana (p haisi 0), uye utsvage uye uise (p, q) 3 dzakasiyana.

y-m-58-01.s.s3.hint.1: Famba q zvishoma panguva imwe kuti kukosha kwose kuviri kuve pakati pe 0 ne 8 kusanganisira.

y-m-58-01.s.s3.fail.c2: Kana p=0, kukosha kumwe chete kunoenderana na x yega yega. p haifaniri kuva 0.
y-m-58-01.s.s3.ok.c3: Kukosha kudiki zvikuru kwebasa ndi 0 kana kupfuura.
y-m-58-01.s.s3.fail.c3: Kukosha kwebasa pa x=1 kana x=4 kumwe kuri pasi pe 0, saka kuri kunze kwa Y'.
y-m-58-01.s.s3.ok.c4: Mutengo wekudzika we function mukuru zvikuru i 8 kana kushoma.
y-m-58-01.s.s3.fail.c4: Mutengo we function pa imwe ye x=1 ne x=4 i mukuru kupfuura 8, saka i kunze kwe Y'.
y-m-58-01.s.s3.explain: Semuenzaniso, f(x)=x inopa 1 kusvika 4, f(x)=2x−1 inopa 1, 3, 5, 7, uye f(x)=−x+5 inopa 4, 3, 2, 1. Linear expression inochinja munzira imwe chete painokura x, saka kana mitengo pa x=1 ne x=4 chete i mukati me Y', ma x ese ari pakati ari mukatiwo.
